hero_sub: Contracted speech and language therapy for schools, nurseries and colleges. Individualised specialist sessions for private clients. Expert witness reports for tribunal. Training for staff, companies and individuals — all delivered directly, without an agency in between.

testimonials.quote: Our students are extremely lucky to have Megan working with them. She goes above and beyond with every learner, making the effort to understand and do what's best for them, rather than just tick-boxing. Learners have achieved more than others ever thought was possible — including one young person who has started to use speech for the first time thanks to Megan's specialist input.

It was a genuine privilege attending Megan's training — and it truly went beyond any training I have ever had before. Megan really understands the struggles of the classroom and everyday life for many of our children, and provided realistic, practical strategies that have made a real, tangible impact in school.

Megan has been working with our child for over 3 years and we would be lost without her. Megan adapts to exactly what our current priorities are, and her down-to-earth, friendly approach engages our son when no one else can. She is really one in a million.
testimonials.attribution: Parent of Child with Additional Needs
